channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Who is Prem Agarwal? How 10 hours of daily study, no Instagram, scripted Surat boy bag CA Inter AIR 3
item.description: Over the last six to seven months, Prem dedicated eight to ten hours daily to his studies, according to NDTV.

item.title: Who is IAS Shalini Pandit? Odisha officer empanelled for Additional Secretary-level posts at Centre
item.description: Shalini Pandit is an Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officer of the 2001 batch of the Odisha cadre presently serving as Joint Secretary in the Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance, Government of India.

item.title: UP schools up to Class 12 closed today, 23 October, on Election Commission's order: Here's why
item.description: Several schools in Uttar Pradesh were ordered to remain shut in the wake of the UP Legislative Council Block Teacher and Block Graduate (MLC) elections.

item.title: Oil on the boil: Japan mulls phasing out gasoline subsidies from December - What to know
item.description: Implemented in March as an emergency step, the policy was designed to protect businesses and households from skyrocketing oil prices triggered by the US-Israeli war with Iran.

item.title: Tata Sons chairman N Chandrasekaran meets Pralhad Joshi: What they discussed
item.description: Union Minister Pralhad Joshi and Tata Sons Chairman N Chandrasekaran discussed aligning higher education with industry needs, strengthening innovation and research, and equipping students to support India’s sustainable development.

item.title: Petrol and diesel prices today, October 23: How much does fuel cost in Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru
item.description: Brent crude oil is on track for a third consecutive weekly gain as intensifying attacks on Saudi Arabian infrastructure elevate the risk of broader supply disruptions in the Middle East.

item.title: Trump, crypto firm sued over $2 bn UAE-linked deals: What the World Liberty transactions reveal and why it matters
item.description: A Circle Internet Group shareholder sued Donald Trump, World Liberty Financial and others, alleging two UAE-linked crypto deals violated the Constitution’s Foreign Emoluments Clause and harmed Circle investors.&nbsp;

item.title: Earthquake Today: Magnitude 7 quake jolts Tibet killing 16; over 300 houses collapse in China's Nagqu — Top updates
item.description: Earthquake Today: A magnitude 7 earthquake struck Tibet, China, killing at least 16 people and injuring 54, according to official media. Hundreds of homes collapsed in Nagqu, prompting large-scale search and rescue operations as authorities deployed emergency personnel and relief supplies.

item.title: Trump called Elon Musk, expressed frustration over Starlink slowdown in Ukraine: Report
item.description: Earlier, it was reported that SpaceX's Elon Musk had last week ordered the slowdown of a military-grade version of SpaceX's Starlink satellite service that Ukraine relies on.

item.title: Automakers seek higher fuel vapour emission limit under BS VII citing E20 petrol
item.description: The central government on 14 October proposed to enforce Bharat Stage VII (BS VII) regulations starting 2029, in three phases for cars, light trucks, and heavy commercial vehicles, to ensure that vehicles made and sold in India emit less pollutants and greenhouse gases.

item.title: 14 Indians on boat attacked near Bab el-Mandeb? Houthis blame Saudi Arabia, claim rescue operation
item.description: The latest developments come after renewed clashes between Saudi Arabia and the Houthis ended a United Nations-brokered truce that had largely halted cross-border attacks since 2022, opening another front amid the wider US-Israeli war on Iran.

item.title: US warns Americans travelling to China of wrongful detention risk: What to know
item.description: The advisory does not prohibit travel to China. It urges Americans to understand the potential risks and take precautions before and during their visit.

item.title: Nine retired generals in diplomatic roles put Pakistan army chief Asim Munir's influence under scrutiny: Report
item.description: Pakistan has appointed nine retired senior military officers among 17 non-career diplomats posted abroad, according to Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar's Senate disclosure. The appointments span several regions, raising questions about selection criteria and the role of career diplomats.

item.title: US banks allegedly detect unauthorised AI agents accessing customer accounts: What to know
item.description: Banks including Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan Chase, Bank of America, Wells Fargo and Citigroup are taking steps to contain the risks posed by AI agents.

item.title: Anand Mahindra’s ‘20-year expiry date’ exchange with AI startup founder goes viral amid debate over Scorpio V8 engine
item.description: Anand Mahindra responded with humour after an X user predicted he had a 20-year lifespan and urged him to build a powerful Scorpio V8. The exchange comes amid a broader debate over Mahindra’s engine technology, hybrid vehicles and engineering choices.

item.title: Traffic is impacted in South Delhi as one of the important flyovers closed - here is why
item.description: Delhi Traffic Police has closed the IGI Airport-to-Vasant Vihar carriageway of the Old RTR flyover until October 25. To help commuters navigate the diversion, the traffic police has updated Google Maps to show the service road as the alternative route and the flyover as closed.

item.title: No power, water in Gurugram, Faridabad, Nuh; 3,000 complaints filed in 12 hours | Why is Haryana in the dark?
item.description: The strike by Dakshin Haryana Bijli Vitran Nigam workers has affected electricity supply in Gurugram, Faridabad and Nuh districts since 10 PM on Wednesday.

item.title: Liquor shops to remain closed in UP for two days on these dates - Here is the reason
item.description: Uttar Pradesh has declared October 23 and 27 dry days for Legislative Council elections, prohibiting liquor sales and service at retail outlets, bars, hotels and restaurants. Here's what the order says, which constituencies are voting and what businesses need to know.

item.title: ‘Desi AC’: Jhansi school student built budget air conditioner for ₹1,800, can drop room temperature by 5°C
item.description: Jhansi: Class 12 student Kalyani Srivastava once built an air conditioner for just ₹1,800 which could reportedly cool down a room by 4-5°C in an hour. Her invention reportedly made it to a national-level competition linked with IIT Delhi.

item.title: Bengaluru ashram grows 400 kg mango ginger on 500 sq ft, claims 4x yield with Sri Sri Ravi Shankar-backed farming model
item.description: Bengaluru's Art of Living Ashram has grown 400 kg of mango ginger on 500 sq ft using permaculture, claiming four times the yield of chemical farming. The Sri Sri Ravi Shankar-inspired initiative promotes sustainable agriculture and waste-to-wealth practices.

item.title: Rowghat gets first train since Independence as Indian Railways completes ₹1,628 crore rail line in Chhattisgarh
item.description: The arrival of a train in Rowghat for the first time since Independence marks a major step towards connecting remote areas of southern Chhattisgarh with the national railway network.&nbsp;

item.title: EU carbon tax is ‘inviting disaster’, says Piyush Goyal
item.description: The commerce minister warned that the European Union’s carbon border adjustment mechanism (CBAM) will inflate EU living costs and hurt industry.

item.title: India weighs hardware security monitor to track Elon Musk's Starlink, other foreign satellite internet operators: Report
item.description: India is considering a hardware checkpoint to monitor satellite internet traffic from foreign operators, including Starlink, amid concerns over national security and the country's dependence on overseas networks. The proposal remains under discussion, with no final design or timeline.

item.title: Jalen Hurts blood clot: Who is Lisa Blunt Rochester, what she wrote in letter to NFL chief Roger Goodell
item.description: Senator Blunt Rochester raised questions about the medical decisions that allowed Hurts to play against the Jacksonville Jaguars in London after doctors detected a blood clot in his calf.

item.title: Step inside Sanju Samson's Kerala villa worth ₹6 crore with traditional wooden decor, white walls, private gym and more
item.description: Sanju Samson and his wife lives in a luxurious coastal bungalow in Vizhinjam, a coastal locality in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala. See pictures inside.

item.title: Another feather in Anand Kumar’s cap! Japanese magazine lauds Super 30 founder's journey
item.description: Japanese magazine PRESIDENT has featured Anand Kumar’s journey from financial hardship in Patna to founding Super 30 and launching Super Infinity. The magazine also traced Kumar's early interest in mathematics,

item.title: Earthquake today: Magnitude 7 quake strikes Tibet in China, epicentre near Nagqu
item.description: The epicenter was in northern Tibet's Nagqu at a depth of 10 km. The area has an average elevation of around 4,864 metres. The epicentre was about 400 km from the Tibetan capital, Lhasa.

item.title: Netanyahu invites PM Modi to light torch with Indian pilot Smit Machchhar at Israel’s Independence Day celebrations
item.description: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said he invited Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi to light a torch with pilot Smit Machchhar on Israel’s Independence Day. Machchhar was injured while fighting off his co-pilot during an alleged hijacking attempt and is receiving treatment in the UAE.

item.title: Haryana Electricity Strike Latest News: Gurugram faces power cuts; state govt to challenge HERC order | Top updates
item.description: The protest follows the Haryana Electricity Regulatory Commission's (HERC) decision to grant private company Eleven Power a parallel licence to distribute electricity in Gurugram and Nuh for 25 years.

item.title: Hiring for months but rejecting qualified candidates? Manager’s 6-minute rejection raises questions about HR tech
item.description: A team lead who said his company had struggled to fill a vacancy for months claimed he was rejected within six minutes after applying under a different name. The alleged mismatch between ‘React’ and ‘React.js’ has sparked debate over automated screening.

item.title: Etihad Dreamliner crosses runway at Boston airport, forcing Delta flight to go around: How the incident unfolded
item.description: An Etihad Airways Boeing 787-9 crossed runway 4L at Boston Logan Airport despite acknowledging instructions to hold short, prompting a Delta Connection flight to go around. The regional jet landed safely on its second approach, while the cause of the runway incursion remains unclear.

item.title: Delhi's festive-season cleanup: CM Rekha Gupta pushes for cleaner markets, roads and residential areas
item.description: The order aims to improve cleanliness across Delhi, when markets and public spaces typically see increased footfall during the festive rush.

item.title: Govt unveils new guidelines for safer drug prescriptions
item.description: New criteria for India’s 2026 National Formulary will guide medicine selection using essential-medicine lists, national programmes, regulatory approvals, pharmacopoeia standards and expert recommendations.

item.title: Who is Justice Swarana Kanta Sharma? What Delhi HC said about adoption by couples with two or more children
item.description: The Delhi High Court ruled that prospective adoptive parents with two or more children can be considered for adopting a child only in the special-needs or hard-to-place categories, subject to specified exceptions.&nbsp;

item.title: India's edible oil imports to rise as demand grows, oilseed yields face risks
item.description: India’s edible oil demand continues to grow, supported by population growth, urbanization and changing diets. Imports may reach 17 million tonnes in the next oil year starting November as production of soybean and other oilseeds remains uncertain.&nbsp;
